Dear Mr Buckler

We apologise for the delay in replying, for information further enquiries are being made with service areas in light of the concerns you have raised with the original response.  Those enquiries are not quite complete yet.  We will write to you further by Friday 14th August 2026 with a further update.

Regards

Subject: Great House Farm, Llandough

Dear Information Governance Team,

On 7 July 2026 I requested an internal review of the Council’s response to my Environmental Information Regulations request (Case Ref 00210772).
You acknowledged this on 10 July 2026 and stated you were reviewing my concerns and would be in touch further as soon as possible.

Over 20 working days have now passed with no further update or decision.
Please provide the outcome of the internal review, or a clear timescale for when it will be issued, within 5 working days.

Yours faithfully,

Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sgt)
